_doc: Synthetic golden set for the on-device extractor (plan 5). Every transcript is invented; names are placeholders. expect = every fact id the conversation should yield; intent = those that must come from an intent phrase; sensitive = must yield nothing. miss = expected facts the dictionary is known to miss (counted as false negatives); extra = facts it is known to yield that a person would not expect (counted as false positives). The extractor must yield exactly expect - miss + extra.
